# Nyzora

> Nyzora turns creative ideas into physical products. Nyzora Originals makes personalized keepsake sculptures — custom pet memorial sculptures, custom pet portrait sculptures, baby name & date pieces, and wedding coordinate pieces — from a customer's photo, made to order in the USA in plant-based PLA with free US shipping (7–8 business days), from $59.

## Key pages

- [Nyzora Originals — home](https://nyzora.ai/): Personalized sculptures from your photo.
- [Custom Pet Memorial Sculpture](https://nyzora.ai/originals/pet-silhouette-keepsake): Pet memorial gift sculpted from a photo, name and dates engraved, from $59.
- [Custom Pet Portrait Sculpture](https://nyzora.ai/originals/pet-portrait-sculpture): Personalized pet portrait for a living pet, from $59.
- [Baby Name & Date Piece](https://nyzora.ai/originals/nursery-name-date): Nursery keepsake with raised name and date, $60.
- [Wedding Coordinates Piece](https://nyzora.ai/originals/wedding-coordinates): Coordinates and date of the place it happened, $85.
- [Pet Memorial Gifts guide](https://nyzora.ai/pet-memorial-gifts): What makes a good pet memorial gift, sizes, pricing, FAQs.
- [Custom Pet Sculpture guide](https://nyzora.ai/custom-pet-sculpture): How photo-to-sculpture works, FAQs.
- [Shopper FAQ](https://nyzora.ai/shopper-faq)
- [Contact](https://nyzora.ai/contact): contact@nyzora.ai, 1 (888) 500-2881

## Facts

- Materials: plant-based PLA, single satin colour, visible fine layer lines (honest 3D-print texture).
- Sizes (pet pieces): Petite 120 mm $59 · Standard 140 mm $89 · Statement 196 mm $139. Free US shipping included.
- Personalization: raised lettering (marketed as "engraving") on the plinth — name, dates, or a short line; optional.
- Production: made to order in the USA; engineering-checked for printability before production.
- Payments: secure checkout; made-to-order pieces are refundable only on defect, with a free remake if the render doesn't match.
